name: FIRE WIZARD
description: A stick-figure wizard in a tall blue pointed hat, a spellbook in one hand and a live fireball in the other.
card: ATTACK  Flick embers, fans of fire, a meteor that lands hard
SPECIAL  Throw the fireball, hold to feed it into a great one
DOWN+SPECIAL  A fireball that creeps after them
UP+SPECIAL  Ride a flame jet any way you point
